transformation.interpolation: NONE: pixels mapped at unit scale; border edge replication only
transformation.coordinate_formula: x_canvas=(347*x_source+82)/512; y_canvas=(389*y_source+61)/512; inverse exact. ROI bounds remain observational approximate regions, not segmentation.
transformation.output: After VAE decode and safety review, remove padding only with crop[82:429,61:450] ->347x389; no resize, no source-pixel compositing. Decode may change source content; must evaluate.

association_policy.authority: Association uses existing OBSERVED evidence/reference_id. No new boxes, labels, target layouts, masks or relations. Evidence is not edit permission; locks remain VALIDATE_ONLY.

mask.proposal: M_KEEP=ones([1,1,64,64]) for both branches, independently of graph/locks/regions
mask.meaning: 1 reinject source latent with noise and retain source latent in conditioning; 0 lets previous diffusion latent survive and removes source latent conditioning at that location. This is latent reinjection, NOT source-pixel preservation.
mask.editable_region: EMPTY by design; does not guarantee reconstructed output is identical
authority_sources: visual_scene_graph/pilot/fixtures/r2b_d_new_01/source_provenance.json: prospective source-preserving dry run, no image permission
mask.authority_conclusion: Allows proposing non-editing source association/reconstruction, not new authored edits. Future generation still requires explicit authorization. MASK_GRAPHIC_ONLY text policy is not a raster edit mask.
mask.channels: UNet9 channels =4 scheduler-scaled noisy working latents +4 scaled source latent*M_KEEP +1 M_KEEP. VAE latent=0.18215*posterior.sample(generator_source).
mask.common_independence: Mask/transformation/source latent/ROI label features precomputed once and reused for A/B and B predicate mutation; do not derive M from boxes or locks.
mask.default_boxes_problem: Pinned pipeline derives mask0 inside grounding boxes; using observation boxes there would silently authorize edits. Future source adapter must provide constant keep mask separately from association boxes.

RNG.source_posterior: Draw once using dedicated CPU generator_source then copy exact z_source both branches; record posterior sampling dtype and generator states. Replace unscoped latent_dist.sample().
RNG.initial_noise: Generate exactly4 channels once using dedicated generator_initial; pinned implementation initially requests9 and replaces with unscoped randn_like when !=4. Future patch explicitly removes that accidental draw path in both branches.
RNG.source_step_noise: Precompute one CPU epsilon_source[i] for each actual PNDM loop index, including duplicate timestep, separate generator_reinject; reuse byte-identical arrays per branch and cast once. No randn_like from global RNG.
RNG.scheduler: New instance from same frozen config per branch; reset timesteps, ets=[], counter0, cur_model_output0, cur_sample=None. PNDM here has no additional stochastic step/eta use. No reuse of scheduler history across branches.
RNG.other: Restore Python/NumPy(if used)/torch CPU/CUDA global states; eval mode/dropout0, deterministic ops pinned; branch-order shuffling in harness outside model seed. VAE decode/safety eval no intentional RNG. Stop on nondeterministic unsupported operation.
RNG.operational_seed: UNAPPROVED; separate settings proposal only; no claim of controlled current seed

M_KEEP=1 at all positions; no hidden state or cache carrying relation effect in future UNet eval

recurrence: l_i=M*s_i+(1-M)*z_i; M=1 implies l_i=s_i independent of prior B output
PNDM PLMS retains up to4 epsilon values. At counter1 it also uses cur_sample from counter0. This exceptional state is cleared; no recurrent branch-dependent l_i survives after source overwrite.
temporal.default_result: For T51 beta0.3 relation active indices0..14. Last possible dependency is output index17 through four-term PLMS memory. From output18 onward history is relation-independent; final50 is independent of B relational inputs under assumptions. This does NOT imply A equals B, because A JSONL text differs throughout.
temporal.end_to_end: Final latent decoded -> safety checker -> denormalization/postprocess -> padding removal. No direct graph side channel in these steps; cannot resurrect erased dependence. If safety checker suppresses output or quantization erases small residual, mark comparison blocked/inconclusive; never bypass safety.
temporal.no_pixel_guarantee: M1 does not return exact JPEG pixels. Even common outputs may drift after VAE/diffusion/decode. Pixel-copy compositing would force identical outputs and is expressly excluded.

decision.plausible_amendment: Keep M1 but beta1.0 at all51 calls, same A/B. B can affect final PNDM step; beta0.3 is upstream default, NOT a selected frozen campaign setting. Explicit operational settings and review required before adopting beta1.0. No approved schedule exists in dry-run manifest.
decision.alternative_rejected: M0 all-canvas keeps prior diffusion state and may retain early B effect, but gives full-image editing region unsupported by current preservation authority. No replacement mask inferred from locks.
decision.scope_dependency: N4R classifies required settings change as scope dependency. Do not close architecture feasible under current inputs/settings.

future_observable.what: B intact vs valid isolated B mutation/ablation at real fuser, UNet prediction, final latent, decoded pre-quantized pixels, final approved image; source/mask/text/settings/RNG fixed. Original A/B rubric stays unchanged.
future_observable.why_discriminates: Need a nonzero final structural influence plus correct held-out relation/preservation outcomes. A/B text difference or decode noise alone cannot attribute improvement to the B channel.
future_observable.acceptance: Predeclare repeat numerical thresholds; structural effect >max(10*repeat_noise,1e-4) at relevant normalized feature/latent observable; final image must show semantically directed effect in independent assessment and no protected regression under frozen rubric. Diagnostic corruption of D is never admitted source truth.
